text:
anna: FYI CI microbench failure on PR #11999, hotloop latency up ~12% vs baseline. CI artifacts: https://ci.redwood/internal/11999/artifacts. Can someone triage?

ci-bot: Automated perf check reported threshold violation: microbench.hotloop > baseline * 1.08. See /artifacts/perf-summary.txt

mike: grabbing logs now, starting a local bisect on the PR diff.

anna: quick numbers from CI: 
```
microbench.hotloop: baseline 1.02ms/op, pr 1.15ms/op, delta +0.13ms (+12.7%)
flamegraph hotspot: kernel_selector::score_prefetch (hotloop kernel scoring)
```

julian: I pulled the runner image and reproduced on my dev GPU. perf record showed L2_MISSES up ~18% in the same call path. Command I ran: `bazel run //bench:microbench -- --profile --case hotloop`

sophia: I think this matches the change in commit 6f4b2a7 that adjusted prefetch scoring bounds in kernel_selector. That PR tweaked the heuristic to prefer more aggressive prefetching for seqlen>512.

mike: bisect landed on 6f4b2a7 as well. Reverting the commit locally drops the microbench back to 1.03ms/op. Repro steps: 
```
git checkout pr/11999
git revert 6f4b2a7 --no-edit
bazel test //bench:microbench --test_arg=--case=hotloop --runs=100
```

sophia: confirmation — revert restores L2 miss rate and kernel selection to previous profile. The prefetch tweak changed batch alignment and increased memory pressure for small KV cache hits.

anna: We need a hotfix: open a revert PR to unblock the rollout. Also add a regression unit that asserts microbench.hotloop <= baseline * 1.06 to catch flakier shifts.

ci-bot: There is a parallel CI run on a different runner that also shows the same delta (runner-7). Link: https://ci.redwood/internal/11999/runner-7

mike: I'll open revert PR now and mark it rollback-blocker. Draft revert title: "revert(kernel_selector): revert prefetch heuristic change (6f4b2a7)". Pushing in ~10m.

julian: We should also add a perf test that exercises the prefetch scoring path (seqlen synthetic batch) and a golden for L2 miss rate range. I'll add a microbench case and a CI golden comparison.

sophia: Long-term fix option: refine prefetch scoring to include kvcache hit locality metric instead of raw seqlen threshold. For now revert is safest.

anna: Thanks team. @mike please assign someone for post-revert follow-up to iterate on the heuristic and add stronger microbench coverage. I'll file a follow-up ticket to track root-cause + new test coverage. :white_check_mark:
